tasks.title: Welcome to Daybreak! 🌅
tasks.notes: Every morning is a fresh start. Daybreak is your local-first, zero-bloat task manager built for native speed on Windows and Android.

tasks.title: Experience the True "My Day" Reset
tasks.notes: Add tasks to My Day anytime. At midnight, yesterday's My Day slate resets cleanly without losing tasks from their parent list—no overdue red badge stress!

tasks.title: Try Keyboard Shortcuts (Ctrl+N, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+M)
tasks.notes: Press Ctrl+M on Windows to toggle Compact Glance mode! Press Ctrl+N to create a task, and Ctrl+F to search instantly across all your lists.

tasks.title: Migrate from Microsoft To Do
tasks.notes: Easily import your existing Microsoft To Do lists via Microsoft Graph API or JSON archive before the June 2027 shutdown.
